entries.deidentified: I stayed in the library until midnight again trying to finish the coursework for the statistics module. The deadline is Friday and I feel like I cannot keep up no matter how many hours I put in.
Another late night on coursework. I have two problem sets due this week and my mind goes blank when I open them. I keep rereading the same page and nothing sticks.

The group project is falling apart and I am doing everything myself. [PERSON] from [SCHOOL] called about the group project at [ADDRESS], tel [PHONE], and I did not know what to tell her. I feel sick every time the group chat lights up.

I have not slept properly all week. I lie awake until four in the morning going over everything that could go wrong, then I miss my morning lectures. Even when I am exhausted my brain will not switch off.
今天晚上又失眠，躺在牀上一直諗住小組作業嘅事。陳小明話佢會幫手，但係到而家都冇消息。我覺得好攰，個腦停唔到落嚟。
